claims.text: Apply a bulk adjustment
claims.note: Tile title. SPATIAL_ADJUST.BULK_ADJUST "Bulk Adjust".

claims.text: Replace or shift the targets of many stations at once.
claims.note: Tile summary.

claims.text: Change the Target VWC of many stations at once, either by replacing every value or by shifting them all by the same amount.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. The dialog edits Target VWC (SPATIAL_ADJUST.ADJUST_TARGET_VWC_% "Adjust Target VWC %") with STRINGS.REPLACE "Replace" or STRINGS.SHIFT "Shift" (sa-bulk-adjust-dlg.component.html:22-43), and the server applies it to every selected station in one transaction (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2287-2428). Results are clamped to 0-50 (SpatialAdjustLogic.cs:93-105).

claims.text: Table toolbar › Bulk Adjust
claims.note: The BULK ADJUST link (SPATIAL_ADJUST.BULK_ADJUST, upper-cased) sits in the bar above the table, between the All Stations / Over/Under tabs and the threshold filter link.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim understand-spatial-adjust/where/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The push, settings and announcement dialogs open over the dashboard from the toolbar (:94-112); the guide starts with none open.

claims.text: A Spatial Adjust account on a site with TurfRad scan data, on a desktop or tablet.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims dashboard-overview/before/1, dashboard-overview/before/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Bulk Adjust edits Target VWC, not the percent adjustment.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. The server writes TargetVwcPercent for the selected stations and recalculates today's suggestion (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2367-2398). It does not touch UserPercentAdjust, so a station with a % Adj. override keeps it (sa-dashboard.component.ts:598).

claims.text: The button stays disabled until at least one row checkbox is ticked.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. It is a link rather than a button. With no stations selected it is greyed, shows SPATIAL_ADJUST.BULK_ADJUST_BTN_TOOLTIP "Select one or more stations using the row checkboxes to enable bulk adjustment." and ignores clicks (sa-table-threshold-filter.component.ts:95-99). The selection is stored on the server per station, so ticks persist across reloads (SpatialAdjustService.cs:1510-1571).

claims.text: Select the stations
claims.note: Retyped from navigation to behaviour. Step title.

claims.text: Tick the checkbox on each station row you want to change.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/1/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Tick the checkbox on each station row.

claims.text: The [[Bulk Adjust]] link above the table becomes active.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/1/5; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Ticking an area or hole row cascades the selection to everything beneath it, so you can take a whole hole in one click.

claims.text: If [[Bulk Adjust]] stays grey, no row is ticked.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/before/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Tick a station row, or a hole row to take all its stations.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/1/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Five stations selected.
claims.note: Figure caption. Sample count.

claims.text: The Bulk Adjust link above the table becomes active.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. The link drops its disabled styling once at least one station is selected.

claims.text: Open Bulk Adjust
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Select [[Bulk Adjust]], above the table.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/2/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: The link sits above the table beside the threshold filter.

claims.text: The [[Bulk Adjust]] dialog opens with the number of stations you ticked at the top, as in 5 Stations selected.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: The dialog opens with the count of stations you selected at the top — check it before going further.

claims.text: If the count is not what you expect, select [[Cancel]] and fix the ticks first.
claims.note: The dialog footer has a Cancel button beside Apply to all (sa-bulk-adjust-dlg.component.html:80-84), so a wrong selection can be backed out of before anything is written. Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Bulk Adjust dialog.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: The count confirms your selection.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Choose replace or shift
claims.note: Retyped from navigation to behaviour. Step title.

claims.text: Select [[Shift]] to move each target by the same amount, or [[Replace]] to set them all to one value.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims bulk-adjustments/3/1, bulk-adjustments/3/2, bulk-adjustments/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Replace overwrites every selected station with the value you enter.

claims.text: The box below takes −40 to 40 for [[Shift]], or 0 to 50 for [[Replace]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims bulk-adjustments/3/2, bulk-adjustments/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Shift moves each station up or down by that amount, keeping the differences between them.

claims.text: If the box shows a number you did not expect, check which choice is marked.
claims.note: The dialog restores the last saved choice and the last amount saved for it, or the defaults (Replace 24, Shift 2) (sa-bulk-adjust-dlg.component.ts:172-186), so the box can open on a value from an earlier visit.
claims.previousText: Shift is the safer choice when the stations were individually tuned.

claims.text: [[Shift]] keeps the differences between stations you tuned one by one.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims bulk-adjustments/3/4, bulk-adjustments/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Shift by −5 percent, preserving the relative targets.
claims.note: Figure caption. -5 is inside the Shift range of -40 to 40.

claims.text: Type the amount
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims bulk-adjustments/3/2, bulk-adjustments/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Type the amount in the box under [[Shift]] and [[Replace]].
claims.note: The amount is a numeric box under the Replace and Shift choices (:45-59). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims bulk-adjustments/3/2, bulk-adjustments/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Apply to all writes the new targets and closes the dialog.

claims.text: The box shows your amount with a % sign.
claims.note: The input has suffix " %" (sa-bulk-adjust-dlg.component.html:54).
claims.previousText: The suggested percentages recalculate against the new targets straight away, so the Suggested column will move.

claims.text: If the box already holds a number, it is your last amount for that choice, or the default.
claims.note: The amount saved for each choice is restored when the dialog opens (sa-bulk-adjust-dlg.component.ts:172-186), or the default.
claims.previousText: If the box already holds a number, it is the last amount you used with that choice.

claims.text: Type over it.
claims.note: The box is an editable numeric input; typing replaces its value.
claims.previousText: On failure. A bulk adjust error normally means nothing was written, despite what the message says: the change is applied in one go and rolled back on failure.

claims.text: Targets stop at 0 and 50, so a shift past either end lands there.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: If the connection dropped after the server finished, everything was written.

claims.text: Shift accepts −40 to 40; Replace accepts 0 to 50.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims bulk-adjustments/3/2, bulk-adjustments/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: The table is not refreshed after an error, so reload the page and check the column before retrying rather than applying twice.

claims.text: Apply to all
claims.note: Step title. SPATIAL_ADJUST.APPLY_TO_ALL "Apply to all".

claims.text: Select [[Apply to all]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/4/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The dialog closes.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/4/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The ticked stations show new targets, and [[Suggested]] changes.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim bulk-adjustments/4/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If [[Bulk Adjust Error]] appears, reload the page and check [[Target VWC]] before you try again.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims bulk-adjustments/4/5, bulk-adjustments/4/7; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Targets updated; suggestions recalculated against them.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Target VWC changed on every station you selected and on none that you did not.
claims.note: Only stations marked selected (with scans, in this course) are changed, together with the other sprinklers that share their names (SpatialAdjustService.cs:2318-2324, :2338-2383). A value past 0 or 50 lands on the clamp rather than the requested value.

claims.text: The Suggested column moved to reflect the new targets.
claims.note: Only for stations with an adjustment dated today; see bulk-adjustments/4/3.

claims.text: The Push Changes count in the toolbar reflects the new pending edits.
claims.note: Retyped from label to behaviour. After the reload, % Adj. follows the new suggestion for stations without an override (sa-dashboard.component.ts:597-598), and the count includes every enabled station whose % Adj. differs from Lynx's Current, leaving out stations pushed today (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:153-160). Stations with a % Adj. override are unaffected by the bulk change. "Pending edits" means those differences, not only your edits.
